method: Archive front image and WGS block edge. Broad intervals include pixel ambiguity and modest front-image perspective. Width/depth stationing assumes the mapped envelope includes both photographed ends and that the hexagonal parapet has a comparable half-width and half-depth. Roof pixels are not surveyed ground points.
vertical_uncertainty: The 30.95 m original host and neighbouring 34.9 m proxy are baseline mesh metadata. Building height is not solved from this photo.
south_facade_photo_citation: 静安区档案局（区融媒体中心2020-06-12）；4137029.jpg，另图4137097.jpg相反视角核角窗
east_entry: District archives identify the main door on the east. Its station/depth cannot be read here. Limit return to the visible tower/window reveal; keep the entire remainder of the short side and entry clear.
aerial: Both archived WMTS editions contain substantial relief displacement from the adjoining towers. Neither provides a sharp six-sided roof centroid. In particular do not identify either rounded wave-profile tower outline or its machinery as the old tower.
